name: clawd-rsi-explained
description: 《Clawd 造 Clawd》— a 4-episode pure-code animation series (Canvas 2D + Web Audio) explaining recursive self-improvement (RSI).

scripts.ep1: EP=1 node tools/render-audio.mjs && EP=1 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 1 zh
scripts.ep2: EP=2 node tools/render-audio.mjs && EP=2 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 2 zh
scripts.ep3: EP=3 node tools/render-audio.mjs && EP=3 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 3 zh
scripts.ep4: EP=4 node tools/render-audio.mjs && EP=4 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 4 zh
scripts.render: npm run ep1 && npm run ep2 && npm run ep3 && npm run ep4
scripts.ep1:en: LANG_RSI=en EP=1 node tools/render-audio.mjs && LANG_RSI=en EP=1 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 1 en
scripts.ep2:en: LANG_RSI=en EP=2 node tools/render-audio.mjs && LANG_RSI=en EP=2 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 2 en
scripts.ep3:en: LANG_RSI=en EP=3 node tools/render-audio.mjs && LANG_RSI=en EP=3 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 3 en
scripts.ep4:en: LANG_RSI=en EP=4 node tools/render-audio.mjs && LANG_RSI=en EP=4 node tools/render.mjs && bash tools/master.sh 4 en
scripts.storyboard: for n in 1 2 3 4; do EP=$n node tools/export-script.mjs out/script_ep$n.json && EP=$n node tools/make-storyboard.mjs out/script_ep$n.json; done
